user.description: Add a PurpleAir sensor near a place on the map, or enter a sensor ID.

nearby.description: Move the marker and the circle to choose where to search. The circle starts at the Home Assistant location and 5 miles. The radius number is in meters: 5 miles is 8,047 meters, and the widest search is 25 miles (40,234 meters). The sensor list stays in miles.

data_description.location: Drag the marker to move the center. Drag the circle, or edit the meters, to change the radius.

pick.description: Choose a sensor. The label shows the sensor ID, the distance in miles, and the current PM2.5 when AirFire has one.

by_id.description: Enter the numeric PurpleAir sensor ID from the AirNow Fire and Smoke Map.

data_description.name: Optional. Leave blank to use Purple Air and the sensor ID.

error.sensor_not_found: AirFire has no data for that sensor ID.
error.invalid_data: AirFire returned data that could not be read.
error.invalid_location: Enter a latitude from -90 to 90 and a longitude from -180 to 180.
error.radius_out_of_range: Enter a radius greater than 0 and at most 25 miles (40,234 meters).
error.no_nearby_sensors: No unconfigured sensors are inside that circle. Widen the circle or move the marker.

abort.already_configured: This PurpleAir sensor is already configured.
